title: Yahya Abdul-Mateen II Is Open to Returning as Wonder Man
excerpt:
The actor remains enthusiastic about playing Simon Williams again.
No new Marvel appearance has been confirmed following the cancellation.
body_md:
Yahya Abdul-Mateen II has made clear that he would welcome another opportunity to play Simon Williams if Marvel Studios approached him. In a recent interview, he expressed satisfaction with the work already accomplished rather than resentment over the show's cancellation.

Wonder Man approached its comic-book protagonist through the entertainment industry itself. Simon is an aspiring actor pursuing a superhero role while concealing extraordinary abilities of his own, allowing the series to explore the relationship between performance and superhero identity.

The first season left Simon and Trevor Slattery, played by Ben Kingsley, with unresolved possibilities. A second season was announced and subsequently canceled, but the end of the series does not necessarily prevent the character from appearing elsewhere in the franchise.

Abdul-Mateen also pointed to audience enthusiasm and Emmy recognition as reasons to celebrate the project. His comments emphasize that playing Simon was already a meaningful achievement, regardless of whether another opportunity materializes.

The actor has considerable experience with comic-book adaptations, having portrayed Doctor Manhattan in Watchmen and Black Manta in the Aquaman films. Suggestions that Simon might return through a Shang-Chi sequel remain editorial speculation. Marvel has not announced a specific project featuring his return.
